description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] During a training session, Chōji demonstrates some of their clan's secret techniques to Chōchō, but she is distracted watching T.V. Chōchō asks her father to sign a scroll about a background check for an upcoming mission. In Otogakure, Mitsuki trains with Orochimaru, and also asks him to sign a scroll.

intro.fallback: During a training session, Chōji demonstrates some of their clan's secret techniques to Chōchō, but she is distracted watching T.V.
Chōchō asks her father to sign a scroll about a background check for an upcoming mission.
In Otogakure, Mitsuki trains with Orochimaru, and also asks him to sign a scroll.

outro.fallback: The two meet up with Sarada and Chōchō outside of the Information & Receiving Centre, but Boruto doesn't recognise Chōchō.
On the way to receive their mission, they meet with Tomaru and Ashina from the soap opera Chōchō watches, who are the actors they're supposed to bodyguard.
